assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code for atherosclerotic heart disease is I25.10
The diagnosis code for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is I34.0
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical need as described in the indication note
